definitions.explanation: A room where people wait before an event, meeting, or performance. Also refers to a green room for performers.

examples.japanese: {出番|でばん}まで{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}でお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: Please wait in the waiting room until your turn.

examples.japanese: {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}に{飲|の}み{物|もの}が{用意|ようい}してある。
examples.english: Drinks are prepared in the waiting room.

examples.japanese: {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}は{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}へお{入|はい}りください。
examples.english: Performers, please enter the green room.

notes:
{控|ひか}え{室|しつ} is a room where people wait before their turn — for meetings, interviews, performances, or appointments.

CONTEXTS:
- {病院|びょういん}の{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: hospital waiting room
- {面接|めんせつ}の{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: interview waiting room
- {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}の{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: green room for performers
- {来客|らいきゃく}の{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: visitor waiting room

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}で{待|ま}つ: to wait in the waiting room
- {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}に{案内|あんない}する: to show someone to the waiting room
- {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}に{通|とお}す: to lead someone to the waiting room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楽屋|がくや}: backstage dressing room (specifically for performers)
- {待合室|まちあいしつ}: waiting room (at a hospital or station — more general)
- {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: waiting room (more formal, for specific appointments or events)
